# Healthcare Data Exchange

> A guided synthetic demonstration of how consent, requesting teams, and regional boundaries affect patient access, with a separate FHIR, OPA, and OPAL backend reference.

The GitHub Pages demo runs in the browser with four synthetic patients and session-local state. It does not call the backend. The local backend reference demonstrates credential-based access and consent distribution. Neither mode is a production health-information exchange, clinical record system, compliance certification, or clinical AI tool.

This supplemental reading index follows the emerging llms.txt proposal. It is not a search standard and does not guarantee discovery, indexing, ranking, ingestion, or citations.

## Start here

- [Interactive demo and guided walkthrough](https://safetymp.github.io/Healthcare-Data-Exchange/): Patient access, consent changes, requesting-team boundaries, and a limited derivative example.
- [Project overview](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Healthcare-Data-Exchange/blob/main/README.md): Purpose, two operating modes, setup, and evidence limits.
- [Product mandate](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Healthcare-Data-Exchange/blob/main/docs/product-mandate.md): Intended audience, supported experience, and scope.
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Healthcare-Data-Exchange/blob/main/docs/README.md): Current guides, architecture references, and historical material.
- [Web setup and verification](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Healthcare-Data-Exchange/blob/main/web/README.md): Static export, gateway mode, route behavior, tests, and GitHub Pages.

## Implementation and backend reference

- [Browser simulation](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Healthcare-Data-Exchange/blob/main/web/src/lib/demo.ts): Synthetic fixtures, consent state, access outcomes, and session activity.
- [Guided walkthrough](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Healthcare-Data-Exchange/blob/main/web/src/lib/walkthrough.ts): Action/result checkpoints for consent and regional access.
- [API adapter](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Healthcare-Data-Exchange/blob/main/web/src/lib/api.ts): Explicit demo/live separation and gateway request contracts.
- [Backend architecture](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Healthcare-Data-Exchange/blob/main/docs/architecture/overview.md): The separately run HAPI FHIR, OPA, OPAL, and service reference.
- [Canonical authorization policy](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Healthcare-Data-Exchange/blob/main/policy/authz.rego): Consent, regional restrictions, and the limited derivative exception.
- [Threat model](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Healthcare-Data-Exchange/blob/main/docs/adr/0000-threat-model.md): Backend assumptions and scoped security boundaries.
